name: Run To Live 2027
short_description: Run To Live is on Sunday 11 April 2027 at Saigon Riverside Park in Ho Chi Minh City, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: Run To Live 2027 is the second season of the race, organised by Miracle Entertainment Group with the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Culture and Sports. The event window is 9 to 11 April 2027 and race day is 11 April 2027 at Saigon Riverside Park, Tran Bach Dang Street (R12 to N13), Thu Thiem ward. Distances are 5 km, 10 km and 21 km, and the 2027 theme is endurance.

core_facts.venue: Saigon Riverside Park, Tran Bach Dang Street (R12 to N13), Thu Thiem ward

faqs.question: What are the age limits and cut-offs at Run To Live 2027?
faqs.answer: The 21 km is for runners aged 18 and over with a 4 hour cut-off. The 10 km is for ages 14 and over with 2 hours 30 minutes, and the 5 km for ages 7 and over with 1 hour 15 minutes. Start times were not published on the page read.

faqs.question: How much does Run To Live 2027 cost?
faqs.answer: Early-bird prices on Pace8 are VND 1,285,000 for the 21 km, VND 1,065,000 for the 10 km and VND 790,000 for the 5 km. The early-bird phase runs from 1 August to 31 October 2026. Race day is Sunday 11 April 2027.
